problems: Overlap: the assyrian-egypt dossier (Egypt as Assyrian vassal, 664..655) and twenty-sixth-dynasty-of-egypt (page: established 664) both claim the Delta in 664-655; the reviewer should either start the Saite state at about 655 or merge assyrian-egypt into it.

Cliopatria's Achaemenid shape of -530..-501 and -350..-338 holds only Sinai of Egypt (gazetteer check), so Egypt's Nile land in 524-501 and 342-338 is covered only by the Cliopatria rows of my two dossiers (which run to -501 and -338, past the dynasties' real ends 525 and 343); the achaemenid-empire dossier (me-05) must add the First Egyptian Satrapy from 525 and the Second from 343, otherwise those years go blank when my keyframes are cut to the dynasties' own years.
The Wikipedia pages disagree on the Persian reconquest year: Thirtieth Dynasty of Egypt says 343 (followed), Second Achaemenid conquest of Egypt says 340 or 339.
Cyprus 550-525: counterparts are inferred from Cliopatria shapes (greek-city-states 24 cells, phoenicia 6 cells); those dossiers should carry the matching losses or the reviewer should drop the gain.
Each state used its full 1-2 page budget (four pages in all); no page failed. The validator warns on the unknown slug twenty-ninth-dynasty-of-egypt until a dossier exists.
